en: One more pair of hands for two hours an evening. That is the whole answer and it costs less than the food I am spoiling by being tired.
Closing one night a week. Everybody says they would understand and nobody would, and I have run that experiment twice.
Doing less. Four dishes instead of seven. It is obviously right and it feels like giving up, which is why I have not done it.
